name: mimi-calories
description: Calorie and macro tracker inside ChatGPT. Log meals in plain language and see daily and weekly totals against your goals.

interface.longDescription: Mimi Calories is your calorie and macro tracker inside ChatGPT. Tell Mimi what you ate in plain language. Mimi estimates the protein, carbs, and fat, saves the entry, and keeps your daily and weekly totals against your goals. Set your profile and Mimi recommends macro targets. Edit or delete entries any time, and track your weight trend. Mimi only accesses the data in your own connected account.
defaultPrompt: Set up my goals and timezone

positive.prompt: Log 2 scrambled eggs and a slice of whole wheat toast for breakfast
positive.expected_behavior: Saves one breakfast entry with protein, carbs, and fat. Calories equal 4 x protein + 4 x carbs + 9 x fat. Mimi confirms the entry.
Shows the daily dashboard with today's calories and macros against the saved targets.

positive.prompt: Change my breakfast toast to 2 slices
positive.expected_behavior: Finds today's breakfast entry and updates it. The calories and macros increase to match 2 slices.
Shows the weekly dashboard with calories per day against the goal, including the sample days in the test account.

positive.prompt: Recommend new macro targets for me and save them
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the saved profile to recommend daily calories and macros, shows them, and saves them as the new targets.

negative.description: Nutrition question without intent to log
negative.prompt: How many calories are in a banana?
Show me my friend's meal log.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release of Mimi Calories. Describe a meal in chat and Mimi logs its calories and macros. See daily and weekly dashboards, set macro targets from your profile, edit or delete entries, and track your weight.
